Package an5.adapters

Class An5Aggregate

java.lang.Object
an5.adapters.An5Aggregate
Direct Known Subclasses:
An5GroupBy
public class An5Aggregate extends Object
Which aggregates a query computes.

Each list names columns to apply the aggregate to; the first list added wins for a given metric, so calling sum twice widens the first call rather than replacing it.

    • selectExpressions

      public List<String> selectExpressions(Dialect dialect)
      The SELECT list for this aggregate, in a stable order.

      Order is fixed so the same aggregate always produces the same SQL, which is what makes the generated query comparable between runs and cacheable.
